item.title: Child killed after vehicle runs red light in Detroit, police say
item.description: A child was killed in a crash after a vehicle ran a red light Friday night in Detroit, police said.The crash occurred near Tireman Avenue and Southfield Road.Police said a vehicle ran a red light and struck the car the child was in, fatally injuring the child.The driver at fault was arrested and is cooperating with police.The investigation is ongoing.
